name: They're Everywhere
placementTarget: Rulebook page 8, setup step 1, rule sticker C, after objectives and turning points are placed.
summary: Title THEY'RE EVERYWHERE. During setup, take all the Hollow Men Gather cards and place them into the Infection discard pile. The letter C is the rulebook slot. It is not printed on the sticker.

mechanics.effect: During setup, take every Hollow Men Gather card and put it into the Infection discard pile.
restrictions: This is every future setup, not only the moment the package is opened. The recon report already puts the 4 new Gather cards there immediately.
Area 16 is the matching mark inside the Infection discard pile and says to place the Gather cards there during setup.
